description: Carbon Intensity is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction This beta dataset provides carbon intensity insights by Grid Supply Points (GSP) across UK Power Networks’ licence areas. It shows blended carbon intensity values for each half-hour period, helping users understand how the carbon intensity of energy varies over time and across different parts of our network. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Network Infrastructure, Network Usage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
